regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional leadership structure: Energy (Oil & Gas) leads on momentum with a mid-durability bar and crowding flag, Base Metals is the challenger with the smallest margin (0.223), and eligible breadth is wide (9/16). Gate discipline is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps=true), but the best-supported use here is staying-power/de-risking, not return prediction. Given a modest 66% hit-rate but only 35% directional accuracy over 95 calls, conviction defaults low; I offer three conditionals rather than a confident buy list.

A broadening of Base Metals breadth above 0.65 would be a stronger confirmation.

The absolute-trend gate help applies here: trend eligibility is the one validated staying-power leg, so an overweight fits trend-discipline but not a momentum-IC call. Crowding (z=1.01, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, consistent with the guardrail against fading the leader.
evidence: gate_helps=true — trend gate validated for staying power on this market

theses.thesis: The challenger sits a narrow second (score 1.545 vs leader 1.768, margin 0.223) with eligible=true and no crowding flag (z=0.89). evidence: margin to leader only 0.223 — closest challenger
theses.dissent: Mean-revert texture plus lower durability (0.52) and narrower breadth (0.556) suggest the theme may already be fading from a local top; it is a challenger, not a confirmed leader, and the detector offers no forward handoff signal.

theses.thesis: Sitting rank 8 with score -0.145 and eligible=false, this theme is outside the trend gate. Since the validated edge here is drawdown avoidance via the absolute-trend gate, a non-eligible theme should be underweight rather than held at neutral. Durability 0.30 and breadth 0.167 are both weak; crowding z=-0.87 signals disinterest, not an invitation.
theses.dissent: In a rotation away from crowded leaders, defensive Utilities could catch a bid as a mean-reversion play, especially with unscheduled macro share at 0.57 hinting at headline risk; underweighting might miss a safe-haven move.
